prompt:
A young adult East Asian female model walking in a modern landmark plaza, almost full-body shot. Low-angle shot from a very low position, person is centered slightly to the left, stepping forward with strong dynamic movement: front leg extended far forward, back leg supporting, purposeful stride. Upright torso, relaxed shoulders and neck, head slightly tilted up and turned to the upper left, looking into the distance, not at the camera, with a calm, confident, and aloof high-fashion expression.

She is tall and slender, with deep black hair tied in a slightly messy low bun with stray strands. Exquisite facial features, light makeup, skin retains real pores, fine texture, and natural highlights, no plastic smoothing. She wears a black haute couture gown: sleeveless slim-fit long dress, cinched waist, high slit and asymmetric wrap structure; upper body features exaggerated sculptural shawl/cape shoulder structure, creating a strong architectural silhouette; small metal decoration at the waist. Wearing black pointed-toe high heels, minimal rings, and delicate ankle jewelry.

Background is a grand futuristic white building with a giant central dome, diagonal white support structures and glass facades, overall axially symmetrical. Ground is an open stone plaza. Golden hour, warm sunset light from the left side outlining the figure and building surfaces, soft clouds in the sky. Overall low-saturation warm gold-gray tone, cinematic feel.

Photography style: Full-body fashion editorial, 24mm-35mm wide-angle low-angle shot, realistic perspective, clear architectural lines, real skin and fabric textures, slight film grain, photorealistic.

Avoid: Cartoon, CG feel, architectural distortion, exaggerated smoothing, incorrect limbs, incorrect heels, messy crowds, text, watermarks, logos.

promptZh:
一位年轻的东亚女性模特 走在现代地标广场上，近全身镜头。从极低位置进行的低角度拍摄，人物略微偏左居中，迈步向前，动作充满动态感：前腿大幅向前跨出，后腿支撑，步伐坚定有力。躯干挺拔，肩颈放松，头部微微上扬并转向左上方，望向远方而非镜头，表情冷静、自信且冷艳，具有高级时装感。

她身材高挑纤细，乌黑的长发扎成略显凌乱的低发髻，留有几缕碎发。五官精致，淡妆，皮肤保留真实的毛孔、细腻的纹理和自然的亮光，没有塑料感的磨皮。她身穿 一件黑色高级定制礼服：无袖修身长裙，收腰设计，高开叉且采用不对称裹身结构；上身具有夸张的雕塑感披肩/斗篷肩部结构，营造出强烈的建筑廓形；腰间饰有小型金属装饰。穿着黑色尖头高跟鞋，佩戴极简戒指和精致的脚链。

背景是 一座宏伟的未来主义白色建筑，拥有巨大的中央穹顶、对角线白色支撑结构和玻璃幕墙，整体呈轴对称。地面为开阔的石砌广场。黄金时刻，左侧温暖的夕阳勾勒出人物和建筑表面，天空中飘着柔软的云朵。整体为低饱和度的暖金灰色调，具有电影质感。

摄影风格：全身时装大片，24mm-35mm 广角低角度拍摄，写实透视，建筑线条清晰，真实的皮肤和织物纹理，轻微胶片颗粒感，照片级真实。

避免：卡通、CG 感、建筑畸变、过度磨皮、肢体错误、高跟鞋错误、杂乱人群、文字、水印、Logo。
